description: Find US railroad crossings near a point. Give a latitude and longitude, and a distance of up to 2 miles (1 mile if left out). Returns up to the 25 closest crossings, each with its crossing ID, road, city, equipment, daily trains, distance in miles and a link to its page.

radius_miles.description: How far to look, in miles. Up to 2; 1 if left out.

name: find_crossings_near
